summary:
Completed PIXELBOUND: Lost Signal — a polished 2D side-scrolling platformer built with vanilla HTML5 Canvas + ES modules (no frameworks or external assets).

Key work this session:
- Fixed a critical layout bug: #menu-root lacked `position: absolute`, causing menus to flow beside the canvas off-screen. Added proper positioning and wired the previously-unused `bindGlobalMenuKeys()` keyboard navigation.
- Rebuilt the renderer after a broken edit, and added an animated parallax "signal skyline" backdrop to the main menu (no more blank canvas).
- Made tower-activation progress frame-rate independent (dt-based).
- Applied saved screen-shake setting at boot.
- Replaced emoji status glyphs in the level select with text-based indicators for a more coherent, art-directed UI.
- Verified via check_project (clean) and smoke_test (ok:true, zero errors/layout issues; player moves, jumps, collects bits, pause works).

The game features: responsive movement (coyote time, jump buffering, variable jump height, fall gravity, dash with trail/cooldown), 3 health cells with i-frames/knockback/blink, three distinct levels (Signal Meadow, Circuit Caverns, Glitch Tower), three enemy types, multiple hazard/platform types, checkpoints, hidden Data Cores + secret paths, smooth camera, parallax backgrounds, particles, squash/stretch, screen shake, impact freeze, fully synthesized audio + ambient music, complete menu/pause/settings/level-select/game-over/level-complete flows, localStorage save system, and touch controls with multitouch support. README.md and REPORT.md document controls, features, architecture, and decisions.
